Pick a run on the left. Drag the slider (or use ← →) to move through depth, and use **Compare with** to put another run's slice beside it at the same depth. Click any image to open it full size.

::: {data-akviewer="" data-src="runs.json" data-mode="run"}
:::

To add a run, see [How to add results](../adding-results.qmd).
